# Juan Carlos Estévez Rodríguez — jc-root.xyz

Senior iOS Engineer, available for hire (remote, freelance or full-time).
Based in Barcelona; Spanish citizen with EU work authorization; open to
relocation (Barcelona / Paris / Amsterdam). Working languages: English (C2),
Spanish (native), French (B2).

## Summary

6+ years of professional iOS experience plus 2 earlier years shipping
production code. Takes full ownership of features and architecture, from
the first call through release. Specialties: Swift, SwiftUI (incl. 6),
UIKit, Combine, Swift Concurrency, MVVM, XCTest + XCUITest (Robot
Pattern), Swift Package Manager, GitHub Actions CI/CD. Modernizes legacy
codebases, builds atomic design systems, treats testing as part of the
craft. On the App Store since 2018 with apps for iOS, iPadOS and macOS
in ten languages. Recently expanded into AI agentic workflows (Claude,
OpenAI, xAI, Ollama), full-stack IoT, and hardware-software integration.

## Selected work

- Living Root — full-stack hydroponic monitoring, owned end-to-end: SwiftUI
  client, Vapor/PostgreSQL backend, MicroPython ESP32 sensor node:
  https://github.com/Living-Root
- Tapper Counters — SwiftUI tap-to-count app (iOS, iPadOS):
  https://apps.apple.com/mx/app/tapper-counters/id6475695007
- MythLog — consent-first macOS system event ledger (HMAC hash chain):
  https://apps.apple.com/mx/app/mythlog/id6797111874
- iCalendarKit — open-source Swift iCalendar (RFC 5545) encoder:
  https://github.com/swift-calendar/icalendarkit
- iBase — number-base converter, on the App Store since 2018:
  https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id1346871946
